data.query:
query Query($where: MasterInventoryWhereInput, $orderBy: [MasterInventoryOrderByInput!], $first: Int, $after: String) {
  masterInventory(where: $where, orderBy: $orderBy, first: $first, after: $after) {
  total
    edges {
      node {
        id
        number
        active
        masterInventoryStatus {
          id
          name
          active
          containment
          empty
          loaded
          mergePrevent
          movePrevent
          picked
          productionLoaded
          productionPrevent
          received
          shipPrevent
          shipped
          splitPrevent
          staged
          system
          usable
          color
          externalId
          message
          customData
          integrationData
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
